aiMetadata.description: Lists submissions for a specific Fillout form (identified by form ID), optionally narrowed by date range, search text, completion status (finished by default, or in-progress), sort order, limit, and offset for pagination. With no filters it returns all submissions; supply filters to fetch only matching ones. Use to retrieve or page through collected form responses. Read-only and idempotent.
